_doc: Read It lines (PLAN §12 D-030). Every word must have a clip: a human recording in demo/audio/free/words/<w>.mp3 or a Piper whole-word clip listed under `sight` (made by make-voice.py, D-010). build.py DROPS a line whose word has neither and says so. Keep lines decodable: CVC words from tools/wordlist.json families + these sight words. The first word is shown capitalised; keep the text lowercase here, one full stop at the end.
